hebrew:
עֶזְרַת אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אַתָּה הוּא מֵעולָם.

מָגֵן וּמושִׁיעַ לִבְנֵיהֶם אַחֲרֵיהֶם בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר.

בְּרוּם עולָם מושָׁבֶךָ.

וּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ עַד אַפְסֵי אָרֶץ:

אַשְׁרֵי אִישׁ שֶׁיִּשְׁמַע לְמִצְותֶיךָ

וְתורָתְךָ וּדְבָרְךָ יָשִׂים עַל לִבּו:
translation:
The helper of our forefathers You were always

Shield and Savior for the children after them in every generation

In the heights of the world is Your dwelling

And Your statues and righteousness until the ends of the Earth

Happy is the person who hears about Your commandments

And Your teachings and words puts on his heart
information: From everyday Shacharis, shortly before Amidah
